description: This file contains the implementation of the RunwayMLVideoConfig class for interfacing with RunwayML's API for video generation and management. It includes methods to construct requests, handle responses, transform data into internal formats, and manage video lifecycle operations such as creation, status retrieval, content access, and deletion.
